prompt: How should the coordinator prepare the test file?
promptZh: 協調人員應如何準備測試檔？
explanationZh: 引號把整個名稱標成單一欄位，並保留原寫法。

options.text: Remove punctuation from the suppliers’ names.
options.zh: 刪除供應商名稱中的標點。
options.whyZh: 名稱文字應原樣保留，不能刪逗號。

options.text: Put quotation marks around only the commas.
options.whyZh: 要用引號包住各完整名稱，不是只包標點。

options.zh: 重新輸入名稱並去掉空格。
options.whyZh: 要求保留原寫法，沒有要求去空格。

options.text: Put quotation marks around the full names without rewriting them.
options.zh: 在各完整名稱外加引號，名稱文字保持不變。
options.whyZh: 引號把整個名稱標成單一欄位，並保留原寫法。

evidenceSpans.speaker: F
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: Put quotation marks around each complete name in the file. Keep the names themselves exactly as the suppliers wrote them. Then test those two rows in a copy of the register.

evidence: Put quotation marks around each complete name in the file. Keep the names themselves exactly as the suppliers wrote them. Then test those two rows in a copy of the register.
